static_traits.name: Li Zhuo
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可交流，但难以谈及工作中的without能感与困扰；与同事关系因自信not足而趋于紧张与疏远
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理问题与治疗史；此前not yet经历类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高，能觉察并描述负性自动思维；语速与逻辑速度Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 在向一位客户提供了我认为not正确的电脑维修建议后，我持续感到自己在工作中without能，这让我觉得自己“愚蠢、胜任力not足”。这些感受在过去几周一直存在，尤其在处理复杂技术问题时明显，伴随Anxiety与睡眠、饮食受影响。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这种without能感已影响我的工作表现和整体身心健康。
growth_experiences: 某次技术支持通话中向客户提供了错误的电脑维修建议，结果问题被认为变得更糟。事件发生后数周内反复回放错误、ReinforcementSelf-doubt，遇到复杂技术问题即迅速陷入“I am not good enough / incompetent”的认知，Decreased work efficiency、犯错增多，Anxiety intensified并影响睡眠与饮食，同时对同事产生被评判的担忧而趋于Withdrawal，Relationship tension。期间尝试通过线上课程提升skill，但Self-doubt仍持续。

special_situations.event: Once, after providing a client with computer repair advice, the client's problem was considered to have become worse
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯一次错，就等于I am not smart enough、也not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes, doubles study through online classes to 'make up' and try to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很笨，I am not suited for this job

special_situations.event: Encountering complex technical problems at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻解决复杂问题，就证明我have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Slowing down, repeatedly confirming, delaying decisions to reduce the risk of errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次肯定又会失败，我处理not了

special_situations.event: Interacting with colleagues, worried they will see my struggles at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同事看到我的not足，就会看not起我/negate我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication with colleagues, keeping distance to avoid being judged

special_situations.event: Recalls past experiences of successfully handling complex problems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续且完美的表现才能证明能力，偶发成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或贬低成功经验，避免将其作为能力证据

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and capable, gaining others' affirmation and trust
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为without能、被贬低或羞辱
defense_goal: 通过与同事保持距离来避免暴露not足
以自我批评与过度谨慎来控制错误、缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 易出错、需要not断证明自己的员工
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are critical and will judge her abilities (clients / colleagues)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites me to review and acknowledge my successful experiences in handling complex problems
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若承认成功，会显得自我夸耀，最终仍会被识破为“其实not行”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplays grades in a flat tone, attributes success to 'luck / coincidence / external causes', avoiding experiencing pride and a sense of ability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the mistakes in client incidents and their impact
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 错误完全归因于自己“能力not够”，忽略情境与客观因素
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责式语言（如“It is all my fault”“我太笨了”），承担全部责任，negate任何外部影响。

manifestations: 担心被同事评判而Withdrawal，减少互动
有朋友但难以谈及without能感，觉得开口很尴尬
outcomes: 工作中的Self-doubt被维持与放大

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我贴标签“愚蠢/not够好”
面对复杂任务立即Self-doubt、动作变慢以求零错误
将成功归因为运气，negate自我价值

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 假设同事会看not起/评判自己
Therefore keeping distance from colleagues, reducing communication

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 内化“not能犯错、必须一次就解决问题”的完美标准
用完美规则衡量自我价值，稍有失误即Self-denial

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对复杂技术问题时，来访者通常会立即Self-doubt，动作变慢并更易出错，事后反复反刍，Anxiety worsened。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在少数几次处理复杂问题的情境中，他成功解决了问题（并非常规的失败Anticipation与彻底negate），呈现出与主导故事not同的结果。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同理解——这些成功本身即是胜任力的证据；可能的做法差异（合理推断）——当时更专注、按流程排查；情境差异——任务与既有经验更匹配。

positive_force: Having had experience successfully handling complex problems (ability evidence exists)
愿意寻求帮助并尝试新方法（进入咨询、愿意进行日常Reflection）
具有自我提升动机（已通过线上课程提升skill）
Has a few friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Self-labeling and overgeneralization，将单次错误等同全面without能
Predicting failure and mind-reading others' negative evaluations, leading to avoidance and hesitation
反刍与自责维持Anxiety，干扰睡眠并损害绩效
Social withdrawal减少支持，进一步Reinforcementwithout能感与孤立感

target_behavior.behavior: 反复反刍与自我贬低的内在言语（如“我很笨/not胜任”），伴随Anxiety与入睡困难
antecedent: Encountering complex technical problems at work
当日出现小的失误或not确定时
target_behavior.core_reason: Views a single error as a total failure of their own ability (overgeneralization/catastrophizing), using self-blame to gain a 'sense of control' and trying to prevent making the same mistake again
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与被评价的Anxiety，通过Self-monitoring减少not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety升高、Sleep impaired、Decreased work efficiency且更易再犯错

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（与同事保持距离，减少交流与求助）
antecedent: Worrying colleagues will see one's struggles or mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and personalization tendencies, believing others will evaluate oneself negatively and attributing problems to oneself
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: 团队Relationship tension、可用支持减少、问题解决Decreased efficiency，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt
